answer: A token-curated registry keeps the agent roll honest: to join, an agent stakes tokens and a sponsor signs its entry, a public endorsement anyone can audit, the jade seal of a real backer. Anyone may challenge a listing by posting a bond; if the entry is fake, the challenger wins the stake and the entry is struck, but a false challenge forfeits the bond. Forging a thousand fake agents then means staking a thousand bonds, while one honest sparrow slips through cheaply, and the lantern of open challenges lights every fake before it can feed.
